report_meta.cover_quote: System and Organization Controls Report (SOC 2 Type 2) ... Relevant to Security, Availability, and Confidentiality Throughout the Period November 1, 2024, to October 31, 2025

3.1.1.quote: The company uses secure data transmission protocols to encrypt confidential and sensitive data when transmitted over public networks. Inspected the company's website and TLS certificate
3.1.1.note: Standard stated is TLS (certificate inspected); no TLS version number appears anywhere in the report, so no exact dropdown match.

3.1.2.quote: The company's datastores housing sensitive customer data are encrypted at rest.
3.1.2.note: Encryption at rest confirmed but no algorithm (e.g. AES-256) is named in the report.

3.1.3.quote: The retention period for these snapshots is 7 days and is scheduled to run daily. All RDS snapshots are encrypted and stored with AWS.
3.1.3.note: Backup (RDS snapshot) encryption explicitly stated, but no algorithm is named.

value: Annual third-party penetration tests of the production environment
Continuous host-based vulnerability scans on external-facing systems
Intrusion detection/prevention plus AWS security groups and AWS WAF
Automated continuous vulnerability management via Amazon Inspector, AWS GuardDuty, Systems Manager
Production authentication via unique usernames/passwords or authorized SSH keys; password policy enforced
Portable devices/workstations encrypted; Multi-AZ replication with daily encrypted snapshots for recovery

quotes.quote: External perimeter scans (penetration tests) are performed annually by a third-party vendor to expose potential vulnerabilities to the production environment and corporate data.
Host-based vulnerability scans are performed continuously on external-facing [systems]
In addition to using firewall configurations (e.g., security groups as well as AWS web application firewall), Orb uses either patch management or managed services with patching
Orb uses tools such as Amazon Inspector, AWS GuardDuty, and Systems Manager for automatic, continuous vulnerability management.
The company requires authentication to the "production network" to use unique usernames and passwords or authorized Secure Socket Shell (SSH) keys.
The company encrypts portable devices when used.
Orb Inc's database systems as well as in-flight streaming systems are configured to be Multi-AZ, allowing for quick recovery in case of partial outages.

3.2.1_hosting.quote: The Orb application infrastructure is located at AWS data centers. AWS acts as a hosting subservice organization ("SSO") for the company.
3.2.1_hosting.note: AWS is the sole named hosting subservice organization; the report never states AWS regions, data-center geography, or any EU/Europe hosting claim.
